doc.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Majoring in English at Jefferson
summary: He majored in English hoping to be a writer and, with Dexter Gordon, earned an A from the toughest English teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So again, you earlier stated that music was an integral part of your education.

But for you, you were not actually performing music in school, that was something you did outside of school. So school really didn’t have an influence. As you said, Sam Brown, no real influence. The experience at Jefferson -­

You know what, in school I majored in English. I was going to be a writer. Dexter Gordon and myself were the only two guys, Hambone (unintelligible); we had the toughest English teacher in the whole entire school -- Jefferson. We were the only three dudes that got -- I got an A in English, man, believe it or not.
